note: Pushed to Grafana Cloud by push-alerts.sh on every release, which also sets what all rules share. Each rule fires when its log query counts more than 0. The service labels come from deploy/alloy/config.alloy.
title: party-quest

rules.title: A Go panic
rules.summary: The backend, or the relay in the game container, printed a Go panic. docker compose logs --tail=200 on the instance shows it.

rules.title: The game server hit a script error
rules.summary: Godot printed SCRIPT ERROR. docker compose logs game on the instance shows it.

rules.title: A container restarted after its process exited
rules.summary: A process exited and Docker restarted its container. Deploys make new containers, so they don't raise this.

rules.title: No logs from the backend
rules.summary: No backend log line over the rule's window, though it logs a regular heartbeat: the backend, Alloy or the instance has stopped.
rules.note: The window must stay well above the heartbeat interval in server/cmd/api/health.go; check.sh checks it.
